scripts.formalOpening: Hello, Amazon Relay Dispatch here. Notice your truck is stopped on route. Everything okay?
scripts.formalClosing: Got that logged with dispatch. Appreciate the update, drive safe.
scripts.unresponsiveWarning: Dispatch checking in. Can you confirm your status when safe?
scripts.timeoutExit: Need to clear the line. Dispatch will message you shortly. Stay safe.

questions.question: What's causing the unscheduled stop right now?
questions.description: Determines root cause (Breakdown, Traffic, Rest, Gate/Facility, Weather)

questions.question: Got it. About how long until you're rolling again?
questions.description: Extracts ETA to resume transit or arrival

questions.question: Do you need roadside service or a mechanic authorized?
questions.description: Flags critical safety or mechanical emergencies
